nodes.norm_label: artifact language follows the codebase, never the prompt

nodes.label: A translated artifact is a defect rather than a courtesy because it breaks grep, breaks reviewer scanning, and silently diverges from the files it sits next to
nodes.norm_label: a translated artifact is a defect rather than a courtesy because it breaks grep, breaks reviewer scanning, and silently diverges from the files it sits next to

nodes.norm_label: the vault plan mirror is a byte copy and is never translated on the way in

nodes.label: mergeFrontmatter copies the plan text unchanged and source_hash covers that whole text, so a translated mirror reads as stale on the next --check, blocks --execute with exit 3, and fails the daily drift timer
nodes.norm_label: mergefrontmatter copies the plan text unchanged and source_hash covers that whole text, so a translated mirror reads as stale on the next --check, blocks --execute with exit 3, and fails the daily drift timer
